properties.feihou_h3_prompt_preview_text:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> <Picture 1>is the adult woman in the reference image, with long pastel-pink hair, white rabbit ears, a white-and-pink futuristic outfit with black harness straps, black thigh-high stockings, and pink ankle boots, standing in an industrial interior.

summary:
[reference generation] The target video shows <Subject 1> smiling and walking forward through the industrial interior while the camera maintains a distant full-body composition.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - her pastel-pink hair, rabbit ears, white-and-pink futuristic outfit, black harness details, thigh-high stockings, pink boots, and industrial setting are retained as she walks forward.

detailed_description:
The target video has a polished realistic cosplay-fashion style, with cool industrial lighting, muted gray concrete surfaces, and soft highlights on the pink-and-white costume.
[Shot 1] A distant full-body shot establishes <Subject 1> centered in a spacious industrial interior with a concrete floor, overhead beams, hanging cables, metal structures, and scattered utility lights in the background. She faces the camera with a gentle, confident smile. Her long pastel-pink hair falls over her shoulders and sways naturally beneath tall white rabbit ears. Wearing the fitted white-and-pink futuristic outfit with black harness straps, black thigh-high stockings, and pink ankle boots, she begins walking forward at an unhurried pace. The camera smoothly tracks backward at the same speed, preserving her complete body from rabbit ears to boots in frame throughout. Her arms swing lightly at her sides, her hair and pink jacket panels move subtly with each step, and the glossy concrete floor catches faint reflections of her boots. She continues looking toward the camera with the same warm smile as the distant full-body framing remains stable until the final frame.

overall_soundscape:
Quiet industrial room tone with a low mechanical hum, faint ventilation noise, and soft rhythmic footsteps on the concrete floor.

non_diegetic_music:
N/A
